installCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && export PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && export PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH && cd ../.. && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=radar
